purpose: Actual independent recent-file manager and protected native opens; not Telari original-runtime differential acceptance.

results.name: successful opens and Save As populate and reorder canonical recent entries without duplicate IDs
workspace previews stay out of history until the already-active preview is explicitly retained
recent-file search, actual keyboard navigation and opening preserve literal Unicode names and paths
canceling a recent-file open retains unsaved source, selection and undo in the original document
missing-file records remain visible and removable without changing the current document or other files
opaque recent-file IPC rejects forged IDs and path payloads without replacing the editor
clear-history only removes records, keeps files byte-exact and leaves document state intact
recent history and capabilities survive a complete restart, and Escape restores editor focus
